propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the backtest harness and the quarterly frozen holdout sets under version control with the forecasting team.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran pre-release backtests for three model versions and published evaluation reports with per-customer error tables.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the backtest work.
